free_tier.stated: No signup credit. 'Developer $20/month $20 in credits each month', and 'Unused monthly credits expire at renewal. Extra credits don't expire.'
free_tier.notes: A plan credit equal to the plan fee. Recording it as a credit would double-count the subscription.

per_object_cap.stated: A persistent VM is 'from $0.0306/hr' for '1 vCPU / 1 GiB / 50 GiB root disk' ('1 vCPU $0.0252' plus '1 GiB RAM $0.0054'). Sandboxes are 'from $0.319/hr'.
per_object_cap.notes: A stopped VM carries no compute charge, which is what makes the 1 vCPU shape usable for less than a full month.

retention.stated: A stopped VM keeps its root disk; the page prices storage separately at '$0.021 per GB / month'. No deletion timer is stated.
